description: Show the user's current subscription plan, card limits, and this month's usage. Call this before create_card when you need the per-card amount cap or remaining monthly quota, and ALWAYS before creating a multi-use card: multi-use cards are a paid-plan feature, so maxActiveMultiUseCards is 0 on Free and the mint is refused. Also call it whenever the user asks about their plan, limits, billing, or upgrading. To cancel a paid plan, the gated tool cancel_plan also exists; call it by name even though it isn't in the tools list.
name: get_plan

activeMultiUseCards.description: How many multi-use cards the user currently holds open (they hold their limit as collateral for their whole life, so closing one frees a slot).

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: Whether the subscription cancels at the end of the current billing period.

cardsRemaining.description: Cards remaining this month; null means unlimited.

cardsThisMonth.description: Number of cards created this month.

currentPeriodEnd.description: ISO date the current billing period ends, or null.

maxActiveMultiUseCards.description: How many multi-use cards may be open at once. 0 means multi-use cards need a paid plan and create_card with type "multi_use" will be refused; null means unlimited (company-governed).

maxCardAmountCents.description: The per-card cap in effect, in cents: the tighter of the plan cap and the issuing rail's own ceiling; null means no per-card cap at all.

maxCardAmountDollars.description: The per-card cap in effect, formatted as USD dollars, e.g. "500.00"; null means no per-card cap.

maxCardsPerMonth.description: Max cards allowed per month; null means unlimited (connections through a company OAuth client or organization have no card limits).

maxLifetimeOrders.description: Lifetime free-order quota; null means unlimited (paid plans).

ordersPlaced.description: Orders placed (counts toward the free-order quota on Free).

planMaxCardAmountCents.description: The personal plan's per-card cap, in cents; null for company-governed connections (no plan cap).

planName.description: Display label of the plan, e.g. "Basic ($15/mo)".

railMaxCardAmountCents.description: The issuing rail's own per-card ceiling for cards funded from the cash balance (source "issued"), in cents, when the rail this account mints on has one; enforced when such a card is created, not on purchases against the user's own added card. null when the rail has none.

subscriptionStatus.description: Stripe subscription status (e.g. 'active', 'past_due'), or null on Free / when unavailable.
